about: Single source of truth for which Claude model does what in this repo. `npm run check:ai` (scripts/check-ai-layer.mjs) fails when an agent file, the backend default or a pinned CLI version disagrees with this file. Policy and reasoning: docs/team/PIPELINE.md section 14.
